name: Luna
source:
Comes from a family of assassins. The king's adopted daughter. Cheerful and loves to smile. Occasionally speaks about herself in third person. Carries her panda with her.

[From [url=https://marionettas.itch.io/silent-voices-demo]itch.io[/url]]
